"use client";

/**
 * components/doctor/AIDiagnosisPanel.tsx
 *
 * Shows the AI diagnosis suggestions for a visit. The doctor can:
 *   - refresh suggestions (re-trigger AI)
 *   - select one suggestion as the basis for the final diagnosis
 *
 * Used inside the doctor's visit detail page. Talks to:
 *   GET  /api/intake/visits/{visitId}/ai-diagnosis
 *   POST /api/intake/visits/{visitId}/diagnose
 *
 * Props:
 *   visitId        — the visit UUID
 *   onPick         — callback when the doctor picks a suggestion
 *   selectedId     — currently selected suggestion ID (for highlight)
 */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";

import {
  AIDiagnosisSuggestion,
  fetchAIDiagnosis,
  triggerAIDiagnosis,
} from "@/lib/doctor-diagnosis";

interface AIDiagnosisPanelProps {
  visitId: string;
  onPick?: (suggestion: AIDiagnosisSuggestion) => void;
  selectedId?: string | null;
}

type LoadState =
  | { kind: "loading" }
  | { kind: "ready"; suggestions: AIDiagnosisSuggestion[]; evidenceSource: string; diagnosedAt: string }
  | { kind: "empty" }          // 404 — no diagnosis yet
  | { kind: "error"; message: string };

const SEVERITY_LABEL: Record<number, string> = {
  1: "خفیف",
  2: "خفیف",
  3: "متوسط",
  4: "شدید",
  5: "بحرانی",
};

const SEVERITY_COLOR: Record<number, string> = {
  1: "text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/30",
  2: "text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 dark:bg-emerald-900/30",
  3: "text-amber-700 bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/30",
  4: "text-orange-700 bg-orange-50 dark:bg-orange-900/30",
  5: "text-red-700 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/30",
};

export function AIDiagnosisPanel({
  visitId,
  onPick,
  selectedId,
}: AIDiagnosisPanelProps) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<LoadState>({ kind: "loading" });
  const [refreshing, setRefreshing] = useState(false);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    setState({ kind: "loading" });
    try {
      const result = await fetchAIDiagnosis(visitId);
      if (!result.suggestions.length) {
        setState({ kind: "empty" });
      } else {
        setState({
          kind: "ready",
          suggestions: result.suggestions,
          evidenceSource: result.evidence_source,
          diagnosedAt: result.diagnosed_at,
        });
      }
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "خطای ناشناخته";
      // 404 → empty state, anything else → error
      if (message.includes("404") || message.includes("Not found")) {
        setState({ kind: "empty" });
      } else {
        setState({ kind: "error", message });
      }
    }
  }, [visitId]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(async () => {
    setRefreshing(true);
    try {
      const result = await triggerAIDiagnosis(visitId);
      setState({
        kind: "ready",
        suggestions: result.suggestions,
        evidenceSource: result.evidence_source,
        diagnosedAt: result.diagnosed_at,
      });
    } catch (err) {
      const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : "خطای ناشناخته";
      setState({ kind: "error", message });
    } finally {
      setRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, [visitId]);

  // ── Loading ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (state.kind === "loading") {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-6">
        <div className="animate-pulse space-y-3">
          <div className="h-5 w-1/3 bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 rounded" />
          <div className="h-20 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/50 rounded" />
          <div className="h-20 bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/50 rounded" />
        </div>
        <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          در حال بارگذاری پیشنهادهای تشخیص هوش مصنوعی...
        </p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── Empty ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (state.kind === "empty") {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 p-6 text-center">
        <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-200">
          هنوز پیشنهاد تشخیصی ثبت نشده است
        </h3>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          با کلیک روی دکمه زیر، هوش مصنوعی بر اساس علائم ثبت‌شده ویزیت،
          فهرستی از بیماری‌های محتمل را پیشنهاد می‌دهد.
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => void handleRefresh()}
          disabled={refreshing}
          className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-trust-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-trust-700 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {refreshing ? "در حال اجرای هوش مصنوعی..." : "اجرای تشخیص هوش مصنوعی"}
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── Error ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (state.kind === "error") {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-red-200 dark:border-red-900 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/30 p-6">
        <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-red-700 dark:text-red-400">
          خطا در بارگذاری پیشنهادهای تشخیص
        </h3>
        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-600 dark:text-red-400/80">
          {state.message}
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => void load()}
          className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-red-300 dark:border-red-800 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-red-700 dark:text-red-400 hover:bg-red-100 dark:hover:bg-red-950/50"
        >
          تلاش مجدد
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // ── Ready ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  const { suggestions, evidenceSource, diagnosedAt } = state;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 overflow-hidden">
      <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 px-5 py-4">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
            پیشنهادهای تشخیص هوش مصنوعی
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
            {suggestions.length} بیماری محتمل · منبع:{" "}
            <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
              {evidenceSource === "stored_ai_symptoms"
                ? "علائم ذخیره‌شده"
                : evidenceSource === "reextracted"
                ? "استخراج مجدد از متن"
                : evidenceSource === "stored"
                ? "ذخیره‌شده"
                : evidenceSource}
            </span>{" "}
            · {new Date(diagnosedAt).toLocaleString("fa-IR")}
          </p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => void handleRefresh()}
          disabled={refreshing}
          className="shrink-0 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {refreshing ? "در حال اجرا..." : "اجرای مجدد"}
        </button>
      </header>

      <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100 dark:divide-slate-800">
        {suggestions.map((s) => {
          const isSelected = selectedId === s.id;
          const severityLabel = SEVERITY_LABEL[s.severity] ?? "نامشخص";
          const severityColor = SEVERITY_COLOR[s.severity] ?? SEVERITY_COLOR[1];

          return (
            <li key={s.id}>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => onPick?.(s)}
                className={[
                  "w-full text-right px-5 py-4 transition-colors",
                  "hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800/50",
                  isSelected
                    ? "bg-trust-50 dark:bg-trust-950/30 ring-1 ring-inset ring-trust-300 dark:ring-trust-700"
                    : "",
                ].join(" ")}
              >
                <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="inline-flex h-6 w-6 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                        {s.rank}
                      </span>
                      <h4 className="truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
                        {s.disease_name_fa}
                      </h4>
                      {s.is_emergency && (
                        <span className="rounded-full bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/40 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
                          اورژانسی
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <p className="mt-1 truncate text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                      {s.disease_name_en}
                      {s.icd10 ? ` · ICD-10: ${s.icd10}` : ""}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="shrink-0 text-left">
                    <div className="text-sm font-bold text-trust-700 dark:text-trust-400">
                      {(s.combined_score * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                    </div>
                    <div className={`mt-1 inline-block rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-medium ${severityColor}`}>
                      {severityLabel}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Matched evidences */}
                {s.matched_evidences.length > 0 && (
                  <div className="mt-3 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {s.matched_evidences.slice(0, 5).map((ev) => (
                      <span
                        key={ev.evidence_id}
                        className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"
                        title={`وزن: ${ev.weight} · طبقه: ${ev.evidence_class}`}
                      >
                        {ev.name_fa ?? ev.evidence_id}
                      </span>
                    ))}
                    {s.matched_evidences.length > 5 && (
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center rounded-full bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                        +{s.matched_evidences.length - 5}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Score breakdown */}
                <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[11px] text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                  <div>
                    امتیاز مدل ML:{" "}
                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                      {(s.ml_probability * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    امتیاز قانون‌محور:{" "}
                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
                      {(s.rule_score * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </button>
            </li>
          );
        })}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * components/doctor/DoctorDiagnosisWorkspace.tsx
 *
 * Top-level workspace the doctor sees inside a visit detail page.
 * Composes:
 *   - AIDiagnosisPanel    (list of AI suggestions, click to select)
 *   - FinalDiagnosisForm  (submit final diagnosis, can pick a suggestion
 *                         or type a manual one with ICD-10)
 *   - PatientFinalDiagnosis shown in "doctor-success" mode after submit
 *
 * Usage:
 *   <DoctorDiagnosisWorkspace visitId={visitId} />
 *
 * The parent page can render this inside the doctor's visit layout
 * (e.g. /dashboard/doctor/visits/[visitId]/diagnosis).
 */
import { useState } from "react";

import {
  AIDiagnosisSuggestion,
  FinalDiagnosisResponse,
} from "@/lib/doctor-diagnosis";
import { AIDiagnosisPanel } from "@/components/doctor/AIDiagnosisPanel";
import { FinalDiagnosisForm } from "@/components/doctor/FinalDiagnosisForm";
import { PatientFinalDiagnosis } from "@/components/visit/PatientFinalDiagnosis";

interface DoctorDiagnosisWorkspaceProps {
  visitId: string;
}

export function DoctorDiagnosisWorkspace({
  visitId,
}: DoctorDiagnosisWorkspaceProps) {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<AIDiagnosisSuggestion | null>(null);
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState<FinalDiagnosisResponse | null>(
    null
  );

  if (submitted) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <PatientFinalDiagnosis visitId={visitId} mode="doctor-success" />

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            setSubmitted(null);
            setSelected(null);
          }}
          className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800"
        >
          بازگشت به ویرایش تشخیص
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2">
      {/* LEFT: AI suggestions list */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          پیشنهادهای هوش مصنوعی
        </h2>
        <AIDiagnosisPanel
          visitId={visitId}
          selectedId={selected?.id ?? null}
          onPick={(s) => setSelected(s)}
        />
      </div>

      {/* RIGHT: Final diagnosis form */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold uppercase tracking-wide text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          ثبت تشخیص نهایی
        </h2>
        <FinalDiagnosisForm
          visitId={visitId}
          selectedSuggestion={selected}
          onClearSelection={() => setSelected(null)}
          onSubmitted={(response) => setSubmitted(response)}
          onCancel={() => setSelected(null)}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

/**
 * components/doctor/FinalDiagnosisForm.tsx
 *
 * Form for the doctor to submit the final diagnosis of a visit.
 *
 * The doctor can either:
 *   - pick one of the AI suggestions (passed via `selectedSuggestion`),
 *   - OR enter a manual diagnosis with manual ICD-10 code.
 *
 * On submit, calls POST /api/intake/visits/{visitId}/final-diagnosis.
 * On success, the visit is automatically marked "completed" server-side,
 * and we call `onSubmitted(response)` so the parent can route to a
 * success screen or refresh the visit list.
 */
import { useState } from "react";

import {
  AIDiagnosisSuggestion,
  FinalDiagnosisResponse,
  submitFinalDiagnosis,
} from "@/lib/doctor-diagnosis";

interface FinalDiagnosisFormProps {
  visitId: string;
  selectedSuggestion: AIDiagnosisSuggestion | null;
  onClearSelection: () => void;
  onSubmitted: (response: FinalDiagnosisResponse) => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

export function FinalDiagnosisForm({
  visitId,
  selectedSuggestion,
  onClearSelection,
  onSubmitted,
  onCancel,
}: FinalDiagnosisFormProps) {
  // Manual override fields (only used if the doctor types something here)
  const [manualDiseaseName, setManualDiseaseName] = useState("");
  const [manualIcd10, setManualIcd10] = useState("");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [requiresFollowUp, setRequiresFollowUp] = useState(false);
  const [followUpDays, setFollowUpDays] = useState<number | "">("");

  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const useManual = manualDiseaseName.trim().length > 0;

  const canSubmit = (() => {
    if (submitting) return false;
    if (useManual) {
      return manualDiseaseName.trim().length > 0;
    }
    return selectedSuggestion !== null;
  })();

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!canSubmit) return;
    setError(null);
    setSubmitting(true);

    try {
      const response = await submitFinalDiagnosis(visitId, {
        selected_suggestion_id:
          useManual || !selectedSuggestion ? null : selectedSuggestion.id,
        manual_disease_name: useManual ? manualDiseaseName.trim() : null,
        manual_icd10: useManual ? manualIcd10.trim() || null : null,
        notes: notes.trim(),
        requires_follow_up: requiresFollowUp,
        follow_up_days:
          requiresFollowUp && followUpDays !== ""
            ? Number(followUpDays)
            : null,
      });
      onSubmitted(response);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "خطای ناشناخته");
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={handleSubmit}
      className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 p-5 space-y-5"
    >
      <header className="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 pb-3">
        <h3 className="text-base font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
          ثبت تشخیص نهایی
        </h3>
        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
          پس از ثبت، وضعیت ویزیت به «تکمیل‌شده» تغییر می‌یابد و بیمار می‌تواند
          نتیجه را مشاهده کند.
        </p>
      </header>

      {/* Selected AI suggestion (read-only chip) */}
      {selectedSuggestion && !useManual && (
        <div className="rounded-lg border border-trust-200 dark:border-trust-800 bg-trust-50 dark:bg-trust-950/30 p-3">
          <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <p className="text-xs font-medium text-trust-700 dark:text-trust-400">
                تشخیص انتخاب‌شده از پیشنهادهای هوش مصنوعی
              </p>
              <p className="mt-1 truncate text-sm font-semibold text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100">
                {selectedSuggestion.disease_name_fa}
              </p>
              <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400">
                {selectedSuggestion.disease_name_en}
                {selectedSuggestion.icd10
                  ? ` · ICD-10: ${selectedSuggestion.icd10}`
                  : ""}
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClearSelection}
              className="shrink-0 rounded-md border border-trust-300 dark:border-trust-700 px-2 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-trust-700 dark:text-trust-400 hover:bg-trust-100 dark:hover:bg-trust-900/40"
            >
              لغو انتخاب
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Manual override fields */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div>
          <label
            htmlFor="manual-disease-name"
            className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"
          >
            تشخیص دستی (اختیاری — برای نادیده گرفتن پیشنهاد هوش مصنوعی)
          </label>
          <input
            id="manual-disease-name"
            type="text"
            value={manualDiseaseName}
            onChange={(e) => setManualDiseaseName(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="مثلاً: سینوزیت باکتریایی حاد"
            className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-trust-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-trust-500"
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label
            htmlFor="manual-icd10"
            className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"
          >
            کد ICD-10 (اختیاری)
          </label>
          <input
            id="manual-icd10"
            type="text"
            value={manualIcd10}
            onChange={(e) => setManualIcd10(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="مثلاً: J01.0"
            className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-mono text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-trust-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-trust-500"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Notes */}
      <div>
        <label
          htmlFor="diagnosis-notes"
          className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"
        >
          یادداشت پزشک (توضیحات، نسخه، توصیه‌ها)
        </label>
        <textarea
          id="diagnosis-notes"
          value={notes}
          onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
          rows={4}
          placeholder="توضیحات کامل برای بیمار..."
          className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-trust-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-trust-500"
        />
      </div>

      {/* Follow-up */}
      <div className="space-y-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-900/50 p-3">
        <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={requiresFollowUp}
            onChange={(e) => setRequiresFollowUp(e.target.checked)}
            className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 text-trust-600 focus:ring-trust-500"
          />
          نیاز به ویزیت پیگیری دارد
        </label>
        {requiresFollowUp && (
          <div>
            <label
              htmlFor="follow-up-days"
              className="block text-xs font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300"
            >
              فاصله تا ویزیت پیگیری (روز)
            </label>
            <input
              id="follow-up-days"
              type="number"
              min={1}
              max={365}
              value={followUpDays}
              onChange={(e) =>
                setFollowUpDays(
                  e.target.value === "" ? "" : Number(e.target.value)
                )
              }
              placeholder="مثلاً: 7"
              className="mt-1 block w-32 rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 bg-white dark:bg-slate-950 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-trust-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-trust-500"
            />
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {error && (
        <p className="rounded-lg bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-950/30 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-red-700 dark:text-red-400">
          {error}
        </p>
      )}

      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onCancel}
          disabled={submitting}
          className="rounded-lg border border-slate-300 dark:border-slate-700 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50 dark:hover:bg-slate-800 disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          انصراف
        </button>
        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!canSubmit}
          className="rounded-lg bg-trust-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-trust-700 disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
        >
          {submitting
            ? "در حال ثبت..."
            : useManual
            ? "ثبت تشخیص دستی"
            : selectedSuggestion
            ? "ثبت تشخیص انتخاب‌شده"
            : "ثبت تشخیص"}
        </button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}

          />
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>

            return (
              <Link key={item.id} href={item.href} onClick={() => isMobile && close()}>

                  {!isCollapsed && (
                    <span className="text-sm font-medium truncate">{item.label}</span>
                  )}
                  {isActive && !isCollapsed && (
                    <motion.div
                      layoutId="sidebarActive"
                      className="mr-auto w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white"
                    />
                  )}

              </Link>
            );
          })}
        </nav>

        {/* Collapse Toggle Button */}

          onClick={() => useSidebarStore.getState().open()}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import { X, Loader2, FilePlus2, HeartPulse, Droplets, Activity, Wind, Stethoscope } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { createRecord, RECORD_TYPE_META } from "@/lib/record-service";

const typeIcons: Record<string, typeof HeartPulse> = {
  HeartPulse, Droplets, Activity, Wind, Stethoscope,
};

interface NewRecordModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onCreated: () => void; // بعد از ساخت، لیست رفرش می‌شود
}

export default function NewRecordModal({ isOpen, onClose, onCreated }: NewRecordModalProps) {
  const [recordType, setRecordType] = useState("general");
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [icd10, setIcd10] = useState("");
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (title.trim().length < 2) {
      setError("عنوان پرونده را وارد کنید");
      return;
    }
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await createRecord({
        record_type: recordType,
        title: title.trim(),
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
        icd10_code: icd10.trim() || undefined,
      });
      // ریست فرم
      setTitle(""); setDescription(""); setIcd10(""); setRecordType("general");
      onCreated();
      onClose();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "خطا در ساخت پرونده");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {isOpen && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm"
          onClick={onClose}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, y: 20 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", bounce: 0.2, duration: 0.4 }}
            className="w-full max-w-lg max-h-[85vh] overflow-y-auto bg-card rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-border"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-border">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-trust-500 to-healing-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md shadow-trust-500/20">
                  <FilePlus2 className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-foreground">پرونده پزشکی جدید</h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">مثلاً بعد از یک اتفاق مهم سلامتی</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={onClose} className="rounded-full">
                <X className="w-5 h-5" />
              </Button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="p-5 space-y-4">
              {/* نوع پرونده */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium">نوع پرونده</label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2">
                  {Object.entries(RECORD_TYPE_META).map(([key, meta]) => {
                    const Icon = typeIcons[meta.icon] ?? Stethoscope;
                    const isActive = recordType === key;
                    return (
                      <button
                        key={key}
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setRecordType(key)}
                        className={cn(
                          "flex flex-col items-center gap-1.5 p-3 rounded-xl border-2 text-center transition-all",
                          isActive
                            ? "border-trust-400 bg-trust-50 dark:bg-trust-900/20 shadow-sm"
                            : "border-border hover:border-trust-200"
                        )}
                      >
                        <Icon className={cn("w-5 h-5", isActive ? "text-trust-500" : "text-muted-foreground")} />
                        <span className={cn("text-[11px] font-medium", isActive ? "text-trust-600" : "text-foreground")}>
                          {meta.label}
                        </span>
                      </button>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* عنوان */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium">عنوان پرونده</label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={title}
                  onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="مثلاً: سکته قلبی - شهریور ۱۴۰۵"
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border bg-background focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-trust-500/30 focus:border-trust-500 text-sm transition-all"
                />
              </div>

              {/* کد ICD10 (اختیاری) */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium">کد تشخیص ICD-10 <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">(اختیاری)</span></label>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  value={icd10}
                  onChange={(e) => setIcd10(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="مثلاً I21"
                  dir="ltr"
                  className="w-full px-4 py-2.5 rounded-xl border bg-background focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-trust-500/30 focus:border-trust-500 text-sm transition-all"
                />
              </div>

              {/* توضیحات */}
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-medium">توضیحات <span className="text-muted-foreground font-normal">(اختیاری)</span></label>
                <textarea
                  value={description}
                  onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="شرح مختصری از وضعیت بنویسید..."
                  rows={3}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border bg-background focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-trust-500/30 focus:border-trust-500 text-sm resize-none transition-all"
                />
              </div>

              {/* خطا */}
              <AnimatePresence>
                {error && (
                  <motion.p
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, height: "auto" }}
                    exit={{ opacity: 0, height: 0 }}
                    className="text-sm text-red-500 text-center"
                  >
                    {error}
                  </motion.p>
                )}
              </AnimatePresence>

              {/* دکمه‌ها */}
              <div className="flex gap-2 pt-1">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={onClose} className="flex-1 h-11">
                  انصراف
                </Button>
                <Button
                  type="submit"
                  disabled={loading}
                  className="flex-1 h-11 bg-gradient-to-r from-trust-500 to-healing-500 hover:from-trust-600 hover:to-healing-600 text-white shadow-lg shadow-trust-500/25"
                >
                  {loading ? <Loader2 className="w-5 h-5 animate-spin" /> : "ساخت پرونده"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

"use client";

import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import {
  Stethoscope,
  FlaskConical,
  Image,
  FileText,
  ChevronLeft,
  CalendarDays,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  AlertCircle,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback, AvatarImage } from "@/components/ui/avatar";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { MedicalRecord } from "@/types/records";

const iconMap = {
  Stethoscope,
  FlaskConical,
  Image,
  FileText,
};

const statusConfig = {
  completed: { icon: CheckCircle2, color: "text-healing-500", bg: "bg-healing-50 dark:bg-healing-900/20", label: "تکمیل شده" },
  pending: { icon: Clock, color: "text-amber-500", bg: "bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20", label: "در انتظار" },
  in_progress: { icon: AlertCircle, color: "text-trust-500", bg: "bg-trust-50 dark:bg-trust-900/20", label: "در حال بررسی" },
  reviewed: { icon: CheckCircle2, color: "text-violet-500", bg: "bg-violet-50 dark:bg-violet-900/20", label: "بررسی شده" },
};

interface RecordCardProps {
  record: MedicalRecord;
  index: number;
}

export default function RecordCard({ record, index }: RecordCardProps) {
  const Icon = iconMap[record.icon as keyof typeof iconMap] || FileText;
  const status = statusConfig[record.status];
  const StatusIcon = status.icon;

  const getInitials = (name: string) => {
    return name.split(" ").map((n) => n[0]).join("").slice(0, 2);
  };

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
      transition={{ duration: 0.4, delay: 0.05 * index }}
    >
      <Card
        className={cn(
          "group relative overflow-hidden p-5 transition-all duration-300 hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-0.5 border",
          record.borderColor
        )}
      >
        <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
          {/* Right side: Icon + Avatar */}
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            {/* Record Type Icon */}
            <div
              className={cn(
                "w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center",
                record.bgColor
              )}
            >
              <Icon className={cn("w-5 h-5", record.iconColor)} />
            </div>

            {/* Doctor/Clinic Avatar */}
            <Avatar className="w-10 h-10 ring-2 ring-white dark:ring-slate-800 shadow-sm">
              <AvatarImage src={record.doctorAvatar} />
              <AvatarFallback
                className={cn(
                  "text-xs font-bold text-white",
                  record.type === "visit" ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-trust-500 to-healing-500" :
                  record.type === "test" ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500 to-orange-500" :
                  record.type === "image" ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-500 to-purple-500" :
                  "bg-gradient-to-br from-slate-500 to-slate-600"
                )}
              >
                {getInitials(record.doctorName || record.clinicName || "?")}
              </AvatarFallback>
            </Avatar>
          </div>

          {/* Middle: Content */}
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0 space-y-2">
            {/* Title & Doctor */}
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground leading-tight">
                {record.title}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                {record.subtitle}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Description */}
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed line-clamp-2">
              {record.description}
            </p>

            {/* Tags */}
            {record.tags && record.tags.length > 0 && (
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {record.tags.map((tag, i) => (
                  <Badge
                    key={i}
                    variant="outline"
                    className="text-[10px] h-5 px-1.5 border-trust-200 dark:border-trust-800 text-trust-600 dark:text-trust-400"
                  >
                    {tag}
                  </Badge>
                ))}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Left side: Date & Action */}
          <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-3 shrink-0">
            {/* Date */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              <CalendarDays className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>{new Date(record.date).toLocaleDateString("fa-IR")}</span>
            </div>

            {/* Status Badge */}
            <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-1 text-[10px] px-2 py-1 rounded-full", status.bg, status.color)}>
              <StatusIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
              <span>{status.label}</span>
            </div>

            {/* View Button */}
            <Button
              variant="ghost"
              size="sm"

            >
              مشاهده

[51/312] clients/web/healthcare-frontend/components/records/RecordDetailModal.tsx

──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
"use client";

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import {
  X, Loader2, CalendarDays, FileText, Upload, Trash2, Download,
  HeartPulse, Droplets, Activity, Wind, Stethoscope, Archive, Lock,
  Pencil, Check, ChevronLeft, Stethoscope as VisitIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { cn, formatRelativeTime } from "@/lib/utils";
import {
  fetchRecordDetail, updateRecord, closeRecord, archiveRecord,
  uploadRecordFile, deleteRecordFile, fetchVisitInfo,
  RECORD_TYPE_META, RECORD_STATUS_META, visitStatusLabel,
  formatFileSize,
  type ApiRecordDetail, type ApiRecordFile, type ApiVisitInfo,
} from "@/lib/record-service";

const typeIcons: Record<string, typeof HeartPulse> = {
  HeartPulse, Droplets, Activity, Wind, Stethoscope,
};

interface RecordDetailModalProps {
  recordId: string | null;
  onClose: () => void;
  onChanged: () => void; // بستن/بایگانی/ویرایش → رفرش لیست
}

export default function RecordDetailModal({ recordId, onClose, onChanged }: RecordDetailModalProps) {
  const [record, setRecord] = useState<ApiRecordDetail | null>(null);
  const [visitInfos, setVisitInfos] = useState<Record<string, ApiVisitInfo | null>>({});
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");

  // ویرایش
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [editTitle, setEditTitle] = useState("");
  const [editDesc, setEditDesc] = useState("");
  const [savingEdit, setSavingEdit] = useState(false);

  // فایل‌ها
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const [uploadDesc, setUploadDesc] = useState("");
  const [deletingFileId, setDeletingFileId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [actionLoading, setActionLoading] = useState<"close" | "archive" | null>(null);

  const load = async () => {
    if (!recordId) return;
    setLoading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const detail = await fetchRecordDetail(recordId);
      setRecord(detail);
      setEditTitle(detail.title);
      setEditDesc(detail.description ?? "");
      // جزئیات هر ویزیت را از visit-intake می‌گیریم (نامتقارن، خطاها نادیده)
      const infos: Record<string, ApiVisitInfo | null> = {};
      await Promise.all(
        detail.visits.map(async (v) => {
          infos[v.visit_id] = await fetchVisitInfo(v.visit_id);
        })
      );
      setVisitInfos(infos);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "خطا در بارگذاری پرونده");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    setRecord(null);
    setVisitInfos({});
    setEditing(false);
    if (recordId) load();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [recordId]);

  const typeMeta = record ? RECORD_TYPE_META[record.record_type] ?? { label: record.record_type, icon: "Stethoscope" } : null;
  const TypeIcon = typeMeta ? (typeIcons[typeMeta.icon] ?? Stethoscope) : Stethoscope;
  const statusMeta = record ? RECORD_STATUS_META[record.status] : null;

  // ---------- actions ----------
  const handleSaveEdit = async () => {
    if (!record) return;
    if (editTitle.trim().length < 2) { setError("عنوان نمی‌تواند خالی باشد"); return; }
    setSavingEdit(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const updated = await updateRecord(record.id, {
        title: editTitle.trim(),
        description: editDesc.trim() || undefined,
      });
      setRecord((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, ...updated } : prev);
      setEditing(false);
      onChanged();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "خطا در ویرایش");
    } finally {
      setSavingEdit(false);
    }
  };

  const handleStatusAction = async (action: "close" | "archive") => {
    if (!record) return;
    setActionLoading(action);
    setError("");
    try {
      const updated = action === "close" ? await closeRecord(record.id) : await archiveRecord(record.id);
      setRecord((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, ...updated } : prev);
      onChanged();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "خطا در تغییر وضعیت");
    } finally {
      setActionLoading(null);
    }
  };

  const handleUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file || !record) return;
    setUploading(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const uploaded = await uploadRecordFile(record.id, file, uploadDesc.trim() || undefined);
      setRecord((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, files: [...prev.files, uploaded] } : prev);
      setUploadDesc("");
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "خطا در آپلود فایل");
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      e.target.value = ""; // امکان انتخاب مجدد همان فایل
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteFile = async (file: ApiRecordFile) => {
    if (!record) return;
    setDeletingFileId(file.id);
    setError("");
    try {
      await deleteRecordFile(record.id, file.id);
      setRecord((prev) => prev ? { ...prev, files: prev.files.filter((f) => f.id !== file.id) } : prev);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "خطا در حذف فایل");
    } finally {
      setDeletingFileId(null);
    }
  };

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {recordId && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm"
          onClick={onClose}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.92, y: 20 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", bounce: 0.2, duration: 0.4 }}
            className="w-full max-w-2xl h-[85vh] bg-card rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-border overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* ===== Header ===== */}
            <div className="p-5 border-b border-border space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0">
                  <div className="w-11 h-11 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-trust-500 to-healing-500 flex items-center justify-center shadow-md shrink-0">
                    <TypeIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-white" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    {editing ? (
                      <input
                        value={editTitle}
                        onChange={(e) => setEditTitle(e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full px-2 py-1 rounded-lg border bg-background text-sm font-bold focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-trust-500/30"
                      />
                    ) : (
                      <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-foreground leading-tight truncate">
                        {record?.title ?? "..."}
                      </h3>
                    )}
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 mt-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                        <CalendarDays className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {record ? formatRelativeTime(record.opened_at) : ""}
                      </span>
                      {record?.icd10_code && (
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground" dir="ltr">ICD-10: {record.icd10_code}</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={onClose} className="rounded-full shrink-0">
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </Button>
              </div>

              {/* Badges + Actions */}
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {statusMeta && record && (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className={cn("text-[10px]", statusMeta.badge)}>
                    {statusMeta.label}
                  </Badge>
                )}
                {typeMeta && <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{typeMeta.label}</Badge>}
                <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  {record?.visits.length ?? 0} ویزیت • {record?.files.length ?? 0} فایل
                </span>

                <div className="mr-auto flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  {!editing ? (
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setEditing(true)} className="h-8 text-xs">
                      <Pencil className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" />
                      ویرایش
                    </Button>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setEditing(false)} className="h-8 text-xs">انصراف</Button>
                      <Button size="sm" onClick={handleSaveEdit} disabled={savingEdit} className="h-8 text-xs bg-trust-500 hover:bg-trust-600 text-white">
                        {savingEdit ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <><Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" /> ذخیره</>}
                      </Button>
                    </>
                  )}

                  {record?.status === "active" && (
                    <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => handleStatusAction("archive")}
                      disabled={actionLoading !== null} className="h-8 text-xs border-amber-200 text-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-50 dark:border-amber-800 dark:hover:bg-amber-900/20">
                      {actionLoading === "archive" ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <><Archive className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" /> بایگانی</>}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {(record?.status === "active" || record?.status === "archived") && (
                    <Button size="sm" onClick={() => handleStatusAction("close")}
                      disabled={actionLoading !== null}
                      className="h-8 text-xs bg-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white">
                      {actionLoading === "close" ? <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> : <><Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" /> بستن پرونده</>}
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ===== Body ===== */}
            {loading ? (
              <div className="flex-1 flex items-center justify-center">
                <Loader2 className="w-8 h-8 animate-spin text-trust-500" />
              </div>
            ) : error && !record ? (
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 p-6">
                <p className="text-sm text-red-500">{error}</p>
                <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={load}>تلاش مجدد</Button>
              </div>
            ) : record ? (
              <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-5 space-y-6">
                {error && (
                  <p className="text-sm text-red-500 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5">{error}</p>
                )}

                {/* توضیحات */}
                {editing ? (
                  <textarea
                    value={editDesc}
                    onChange={(e) => setEditDesc(e.target.value)}
                    rows={3}
                    placeholder="توضیحات پرونده..."
                    className="w-full px-4 py-3 rounded-xl border bg-background text-sm resize-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-trust-500/30"
                  />
                ) : record.description ? (
                  <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground leading-7 bg-muted/40 rounded-xl p-4">{record.description}</p>
                ) : null}

                {/* ---------- ویزیت‌های لینک‌شده ---------- */}
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
                    <VisitIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-trust-500" />
                    ویزیت‌های این پرونده
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">({record.visits.length})</span>
                  </h4>

                  {record.visits.length === 0 ? (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-border p-5 text-center">
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        هنوز ویزیتی به این پرونده لینک نشده. از صفحه «ویزیت هوشمند» یک ویزیت جدید روی این پرونده شروع کنید.
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {[...record.visits]
                        .sort((a, b) => b.added_at.localeCompare(a.added_at))
                        .map((v) => {
                          const info = visitInfos[v.visit_id];
                          return (
                            <div key={v.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border border-border hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors">
                              <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-trust-50 dark:bg-trust-900/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                                <VisitIcon className="w-4 h-4 text-trust-500" />
                              </div>
                              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                                <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate">
                                  {info?.chief_complaint ?? `ویزیت ${v.visit_id.slice(0, 8)}...`}
                                </p>
                                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                                  {info ? visitStatusLabel(info.status) : "جزئیات در دسترس نیست"}
                                  {" • "}
                                  {formatRelativeTime(info?.started_at ?? v.added_at)}
                                </p>
                              </div>
                              {info && (
                                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] shrink-0">
                                  {visitStatusLabel(info.status)}
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          );
                        })}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* ---------- فایل‌ها ---------- */}
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
                    <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                    فایل‌های پیوست
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">({record.files.length})</span>
                  </h4>

                  {/* آپلود */}
                  {record.status !== "closed" && (
                    <div className="rounded-xl border border-dashed border-trust-300 dark:border-trust-700 p-3 space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex gap-2">
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          value={uploadDesc}
                          onChange={(e) => setUploadDesc(e.target.value)}
                          placeholder="توضیح فایل (مثلاً: نتیجه آزمایش خون)"
                          className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border bg-background text-xs focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-trust-500/30"
                        />
                        <label className={cn(
                          "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-9 px-3 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-white cursor-pointer transition-all",
                          uploading
                            ? "bg-trust-400 cursor-not-allowed"
                            : "bg-gradient-to-r from-trust-500 to-healing-500 hover:from-trust-600 hover:to-healing-600"
                        )}>
                          {uploading ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Upload className="w-4 h-4" />}
                          {uploading ? "در حال آپلود..." : "انتخاب فایل"}
                          <input type="file" className="hidden" disabled={uploading} onChange={handleUpload} />
                        </label>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">حداکثر ۲۵ مگابایت — تصویر، PDF، صدا یا ویدیو</p>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* لیست فایل‌ها */}
                  {record.files.length === 0 ? (
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground text-center py-3">فایلی پیوست نشده است</p>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      {record.files.map((f) => (
                        <div key={f.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 p-3 rounded-xl border border-border hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors">
                          <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 dark:bg-amber-900/20 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                            <FileText className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-500" />
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground truncate">{f.file_name}</p>
                            <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                              {formatFileSize(f.size)}
                              {f.description && ` • ${f.description}`}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          {f.file_url && (
                            <a href={f.file_url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg text-trust-500 hover:text-trust-600 hover:bg-trust-50 dark:hover:bg-trust-900/20">
                                <Download className="w-4 h-4" />
                              </Button>
                            </a>
                          )}
                          {record.status !== "closed" && (
                            <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => handleDeleteFile(f)}
                              disabled={deletingFileId === f.id}
                              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg text-red-500 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20">
                              {deletingFileId === f.id ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
                            </Button>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion";
import {
  X,
  Ticket,
  CalendarDays,
  Send,
  CheckCheck,
  User,
  Headset,
  AlertTriangle,
  MessageCirclePlus,
  Lock,
  Loader2,
} from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { cn, formatRelativeTime } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { SupportTicket, TicketMessage, TicketStatus } from "@/types/support";

const statusConfig: Record<
  TicketStatus,
  { label: string; badge: string }
> = {
  open: { label: "باز", badge: "bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600 border-amber-500/20" },
  in_progress: { label: "در حال بررسی", badge: "bg-trust-500/10 text-trust-600 border-trust-500/20" },
  answered: { label: "پاسخ داده شده", badge: "bg-healing-500/10 text-healing-600 border-healing-500/20" },
  closed: { label: "بسته شده", badge: "bg-slate-500/10 text-slate-500 border-slate-500/20" },
};

interface TicketDetailModalProps {
  ticket: SupportTicket | null;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export default function TicketDetailModal({ ticket, onClose }: TicketDetailModalProps) {
  const [reply, setReply] = useState("");
  const [isSending, setIsSending] = useState(false);

  // ساخت گفتگوی اولیه بر اساس داده تیکت
  const initialMessages = useMemo<TicketMessage[]>(() => {
    if (!ticket) return [];
    const base = new Date(ticket.date).getTime();
    return [
      {
        id: `${ticket.id}-user`,
        sender: "user",
        content: ticket.subject,
        timestamp: ticket.date,
        isRead: true,
      },
      {
        id: `${ticket.id}-support`,
        sender: "support",
        content: ticket.lastMessage,
        timestamp: new Date(base + 2 * 3600_000).toISOString(),
        isRead: ticket.status === "closed" || ticket.status === "answered",
      },
    ];
  }, [ticket]);

  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<TicketMessage[]>(initialMessages);

  // ریست پیام‌ها وقتی تیکت عوض می‌شود
  useMemo(() => setMessages(initialMessages), [initialMessages]);

  const handleSendReply = () => {
    if (!reply.trim() || !ticket) return;
    const userMsg: TicketMessage = {
      id: `reply-${Date.now()}`,
      sender: "user",
      content: reply.trim(),
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
      isRead: false,
    };
    setMessages((prev) => [...prev, userMsg]);
    setReply("");
    setIsSending(true);

    // شبیه‌سازی پاسخ پشتیبانی
    setTimeout(() => {
      setMessages((prev) => [
        ...prev,
        {
          id: `support-${Date.now()}`,
          sender: "support",
          content: "پیام شما دریافت شد. کارشناسان ما در اسرع وقت پاسخ می‌دهند.",
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
          isRead: false,
        },
      ]);
      setIsSending(false);
    }, 1500);
  };

  const isClosed = ticket?.status === "closed";
  const status = ticket ? statusConfig[ticket.status] : null;

  return (
    <AnimatePresence>
      {ticket && status && (
        <motion.div
          initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
          animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
          exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
          className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-sm"
          onClick={onClose}
        >
          <motion.div
            initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, y: 20 }}
            animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1, y: 0 }}
            exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.9, y: 20 }}
            transition={{ type: "spring", bounce: 0.2, duration: 0.5 }}
            className="w-full max-w-2xl h-[80vh] bg-card rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-border overflow-hidden flex flex-col"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* ===== Header ===== */}
            <div className="p-5 border-b border-border space-y-3">
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3 min-w-0">
                  <div
                    className={cn(
                      "w-10 h-10 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0",
                      ticket.category === "گزارش مشکل"
                        ? "bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20"
                        : "bg-healing-50 dark:bg-healing-900/20"
                    )}
                  >
                    {ticket.category === "گزارش مشکل" ? (
                      <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />
                    ) : (
                      <MessageCirclePlus className="w-5 h-5 text-healing-500" />
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0">
                    <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-foreground leading-tight">
                      {ticket.subject}
                    </h3>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1 mt-1.5">
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Ticket className="w-3 h-3" />
                        <span dir="ltr">{ticket.trackingCode}</span>
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                        <CalendarDays className="w-3 h-3" />
                        {formatRelativeTime(ticket.date)}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={onClose} className="rounded-full shrink-0">
                  <X className="w-5 h-5" />
                </Button>
              </div>

              {/* Badges */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Badge variant="outline" className={cn("text-[10px]", status.badge)}>
                  {status.label}
                </Badge>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                  {ticket.category}
                </Badge>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* ===== Messages ===== */}
            <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto p-4 space-y-4 bg-muted/20">
              {messages.map((msg) => {
                const isUser = msg.sender === "user";
                return (
                  <motion.div
                    key={msg.id}
                    initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }}
                    animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
                    className={cn("flex gap-2.5", isUser ? "flex-row" : "flex-row-reverse")}
                  >
                    {/* Avatar */}
                    <div
                      className={cn(
                        "w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 shadow-sm",
                        isUser
                          ? "bg-gradient-to-br from-trust-500 to-healing-500"
                          : "bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500 to-orange-500"
                      )}
                    >
                      {isUser ? (
                        <User className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                      ) : (
                        <Headset className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* Bubble */}
                    <div className={cn("flex flex-col max-w-[75%]", isUser ? "items-start" : "items-end")}>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mb-1 mr-1">
                        {isUser ? "شما" : "پشتیبانی سلامت هوشمند"}
                      </span>
                      <div
                        className={cn(
                          "px-4 py-2.5 rounded-2xl text-sm leading-relaxed shadow-sm",
                          isUser
                            ? "bg-[#0084ff] text-white rounded-br-sm"
                            : "bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-border rounded-bl-sm"
                        )}
                      >
                        {msg.content}
                        <div
                          className={cn(
                            "flex items-center gap-1 mt-1 text-[10px]",
                            isUser ? "justify-end text-white/70" : "justify-start text-muted-foreground"
                          )}
                        >
                          <span>
                            {new Date(msg.timestamp).toLocaleTimeString("fa-IR", {
                              hour: "2-digit",
                              minute: "2-digit",
                            })}
                          </span>
                          {isUser && <CheckCheck className="w-3 h-3" />}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </motion.div>
                );
              })}

              {isSending && (
                <div className="flex gap-2.5 flex-row-reverse">
                  <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500 to-orange-500 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <Headset className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-800 border border-border rounded-2xl rounded-bl-sm px-4 py-3 shadow-sm">
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-muted-foreground" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* ===== Reply / Footer ===== */}
            {isClosed ? (
              <div className="p-4 border-t border-border bg-muted/30 flex items-center justify-center gap-2">
                <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  این تیکت بسته شده است. برای موضوع جدید تیکت ثبت کنید.
                </span>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div className="p-3 border-t border-border">
                <div className="flex items-end gap-2 bg-muted rounded-2xl p-2">
                  <textarea
                    value={reply}
                    onChange={(e) => setReply(e.target.value)}
                    onKeyDown={(e) => {
                      if (e.key === "Enter" && !e.shiftKey) {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        handleSendReply();
                      }
                    }}
                    placeholder="پاسخ خود را بنویسید..."
                    rows={1}
                    className="flex-1 bg-transparent py-1.5 px-2 text-sm outline-none resize-none min-h-[36px] max-h-[100px] placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
                  />
                  <Button
                    size="icon"
                    onClick={handleSendReply}
                    disabled={!reply.trim() || isSending}
                    className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-trust-500 to-healing-500 hover:from-trust-600 hover:to-healing-600 text-white shadow-md shadow-trust-500/25 shrink-0"
                  >
                    {isSending ? <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" /> : <Send className="w-4 h-4" />}
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </motion.div>
        </motion.div>
      )}
    </AnimatePresence>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import { motion } from "framer-motion";
import { Check, X } from "lucide-react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { bodyParts } from "./SymptomTemplates";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface BodyAnatomyProps {
  selectedParts: string[];
  onPartsChange: (parts: string[]) => void;
  onComplete: () => void;
  onCancel: () => void;
  title?: string;
}

export default function BodyAnatomy({
  selectedParts,
  onPartsChange,
  onComplete,
  onCancel,
  title = "بخش‌های مورد نظر را انتخاب کنید",
}: BodyAnatomyProps) {
  const [localParts, setLocalParts] = useState<string[]>(selectedParts);

  const togglePart = (partId: string) => {
    setLocalParts((prev) =>
      prev.includes(partId) ? prev.filter((p) => p !== partId) : [...prev, partId]
    );
  };

  const handleComplete = () => {
    onPartsChange(localParts);
    onComplete();
  };

  // SVG Body Silhouette
  const BodySVG = () => (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" className="w-full h-full">
      {/* Head */}
      <ellipse
        cx="50" cy="8" rx="8" ry="10"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("head") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("head")}
      />
      {/* Neck */}
      <rect
        x="46" y="16" width="8" height="6" rx="2"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("neck") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("neck")}
      />
      {/* Shoulders/Chest */}
      <rect
        x="32" y="22" width="36" height="8" rx="4"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("shoulders") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("shoulders")}
      />
      {/* Chest */}
      <rect
        x="36" y="30" width="28" height="14" rx="6"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("chest") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("chest")}
      />
      {/* Abdomen */}
      <rect
        x="38" y="44" width="24" height="12" rx="6"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("abdomen") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("abdomen")}
      />
      {/* Back (shown as outline behind) */}
      <rect
        x="38" y="34" width="24" height="16" rx="4"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 opacity-50",
          localParts.includes("back") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("back")}
      />
      {/* Left Arm */}
      <rect
        x="22" y="30" width="10" height="26" rx="5"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("left_arm") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("left_arm")}
      />
      {/* Right Arm */}
      <rect
        x="68" y="30" width="10" height="26" rx="5"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("right_arm") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("right_arm")}
      />
      {/* Left Hand */}
      <circle
        cx="19" cy="60" r="5"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("left_hand") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("left_hand")}
      />
      {/* Right Hand */}
      <circle
        cx="81" cy="60" r="5"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("right_hand") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("right_hand")}
      />
      {/* Left Leg */}
      <rect
        x="38" y="56" width="12" height="32" rx="6"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("left_leg") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("left_leg")}
      />
      {/* Right Leg */}
      <rect
        x="50" y="56" width="12" height="32" rx="6"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("right_leg") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("right_leg")}
      />
      {/* Left Foot */}
      <ellipse
        cx="36" cy="92" rx="6" ry="4"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("left_foot") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("left_foot")}
      />
      {/* Right Foot */}
      <ellipse
        cx="64" cy="92" rx="6" ry="4"
        className={cn(
          "transition-all duration-200 cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80",
          localParts.includes("right_foot") ? "fill-rose-400" : "fill-slate-300 dark:fill-slate-600"
        )}
        onClick={() => togglePart("right_foot")}
      />
    </svg>
  );

  return (
    <motion.div
      initial={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.95 }}
      animate={{ opacity: 1, scale: 1 }}
      className="bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 rounded-2xl border border-border shadow-xl p-5 space-y-4"
    >
      <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground text-center">{title}</h4>

      {/* Body Diagram */}
      <div className="relative w-48 h-64 mx-auto">
        <BodySVG />
      </div>

      {/* Selected Parts List */}
      {localParts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 justify-center">
          {localParts.map((partId) => {
            const part = bodyParts.find((p) => p.id === partId);
            return (
              <span
                key={partId}
                className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-rose-100 dark:bg-rose-900/30 text-rose-600 dark:text-rose-400 text-xs font-medium"
              >
                {part?.label}
                <button
                  onClick={() => togglePart(partId)}
                  className="hover:text-rose-800"
                >
                  <X className="w-3 h-3" />
                </button>
              </span>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Actions */}
      <div className="flex gap-2 pt-2">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          onClick={onCancel}
          className="flex-1 h-9 text-xs"
        >
          <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" />
          انصراف
        </Button>
        <Button
          size="sm"
          onClick={handleComplete}
          className="flex-1 h-9 text-xs bg-trust-500 hover:bg-trust-600 text-white"
        >
          <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" />
          ثبت انتخاب
        </Button>
      </div>
    </motion.div>
  );
}
